children: The India rupee surged in the non-deliverable forward market, signalling a rally at Monday's open after the Reserve Bank of India stepped up efforts to curb dollar demand and stem the currency's slide.
The one-month dollar/rupee NDF contract indicated the rupee could rally about 1% from Friday's close of 96.73 when local markets open on Monday.
